name: – Daniel Freund – § 9 – Am 11
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2024, Section III – Commission and executive agencies and the ninth, tenth and eleventh European Development Funds
part_text: 9. Stresses that Members of the Commission must meet the highest standards of integrity, independence and accountability, both in their current functions and in their previous roles; notes with concern the ongoing judicial investigation in Spain into alleged corruption linked to Forestalia Renovables S.L. and renewable energy authorisations involving senior officials from the Spanish Ministry for the Ecological Transition and the Demographic Challenge during the period in which the current Executive Vice-President for a Clean, Just and Competitive Transition served as Minister responsable for that portfolio; regrets the absence of full and transparent explanations regarding the responsibility arising from those events; considers that, taken together, the political responsibility exercised over that area, the institutional links with senior officials currently under investigation and the lack of public explanations demonstrate a pattern that is incompatible with the standards of accountability, reliability and sound administration required of a Member of the Commission;
